name: What kind of sample do I need to provide for paint color matching?
description: Provide a clean paint chip or a small section of the existing painted surface, about the size of a quarter, for the best color match.

mainEntity.name: What kind of sample do I need to provide for paint color matching?

acceptedAnswer.text: To achieve the best paint color match, we ideally need a paint chip or a small section of the existing painted surface, roughly the size of a quarter or larger. If providing a chip, ensure it is clean and free of dirt. For walls, a piece of drywall or trim can work. If no physical sample is available, clear, high-resolution photographs taken in natural light can sometimes help, but a physical sample offers the highest accuracy for precise pigment analysis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide a clean paint chip or a small section of the existing painted surface, about the size of a quarter, for the best color match.
